title: Cookbook:Sour Lamp Bread
source:
{{recipesummary | Category = Bread recipes | Servings = 8 | Time = Fermentation: 12–24 hours
Cooking: 5 minutes per loaf | Difficulty = 2 }} A '''sour lamp bread''' is left to sour before it ever meets a pan. == Ingredients == * 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] hard flour * 1½ cups warm water == Procedure == # Mix the flour and the water and leave the batter to sour. # Cook thin rounds of it on a dry pan.
